notes: Section 4 (Sutro Heights to Ocean Beach), 1-bit photocopy. Sides (README rule 1): the innermost rule is the thin rule inside the thick bar on all four sides. Its inner edge was measured every 20 px wherever paper lies beside it (a sample only counts if a ~3-5 px dark run sits 2-12 px inside the thick bar and within 3 px of a cubic fitted along the side), fitted locally (+-120 px, robust linear) and the outline set ~1.8 px inside it, points every ~120 px (the top rule wobbles 3-5 px over a few hundred px). Corners (rule 2): each corner has a thick and a thin quarter arc; the thin arc's inner edge was measured along rays from the arc centre (median-filtered scan, thin run next to the thick arc with paper inside), fitted with a circle plus a quadratic in angle (residual ~0.2 px), and the outline runs ~2.2 px inside it, points every ~30 px. Where each arc meets a side, its tail runs ~8-12 px inside the rule and joins it through a short connector; the outline follows the connector's map-side face (TL x 475 / y 562, TR x 4869 / y 578, BR y 3732 / x 4873, BL x 469 / y 3742), so the connector and the gap between tail and rule are outside. Kind b (map ink truly touching the rule): the solid and outlined blocks of the left-hand column (x ~246-280) run into the left thin rule over most of its length, and the Great Highway lines meet it at y ~990-1040; there the outline follows the rule's inner edge fitted from the streets either side, through the block ink. Bottom: hatched-block lines and lot lines reach the bottom rule in many places. BL corner: the left-column blocks 1725/1726 and the solid block at x 305-340 run across the thin arc; the arc there is the fitted curve (measured where the arc is clear, angles 92-128 and 143-162 deg), and the block parts beyond it are outside. Remove (rule 4): (1) the rotated CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP 1929 title, legend and scale block (no ruled box; open paper; rectangle ~4 px outside its ink), (2) the compass rose with its three long arrows (8-point convex outline ~5 px outside the ink, all paper inside apart from specks), (3) the SECTION 4 badge (octagon ~5 px outside the ring, clear of the BR arc). 'Join Sec 5' (left of the left bar) and 'Join Sec 3' (below the bottom bar) print outside the frame. PACIFIC OCEAN, park and street names are map. Doubt: at the BL arc's top end (y 3742) the block fuses with the arc tail and the rule, so the left step is placed by the hook visible at y ~3741-3745.
